machines.title: Ingest idempotency
machines.blurb: The same source and sourceId stay one row.

invariants.name: OneRowPerKey
invariants.text: One source and sourceId produce at most one row.

invariants.name: RepeatStaysQuiet
invariants.text: A repeat of the same key does not add a second row.

story.label: The key has not been seen.
The same key again. Still one row.

machines.title: Token lifecycle
machines.blurb: Sync still sends the access token after expires_at.

invariants.name: ExpiredTokenNotUsed
invariants.text: An expired access token is not used to sync.

invariants.name: NoSyncWithoutToken
invariants.text: Sync does not run when no token is stored.

trace.label: Past expires_at
trace.sourceRef: expires_at is stored and never read again

story.label: The code exchange stores an access token.
expires_at has passed. The file is unchanged.
Sync reads access_token and uses it anyway.

machines.title: Live stream
